note: Each coSWID section is carved directly from the attacker-controlled uSWID payload.
The coSWID bytes are decoded as CBOR, preserving the attacker-selected map and array item types.
The hash field only has to be a non-empty CBOR array to enter hash parsing.
A two-element hash array with a non-array first element is passed as a single hash tuple.
The second array element is accepted when it is merely present; its CBOR major type is not checked before bytestring APIs are used.
The parser calls bytestring accessors on an attacker-controlled item that can be an integer, producing the out-of-bounds read reported by ASan.
